digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure and CI/CD test harness
key_entities: PT001 PT006 PT007 PT008 PT012 PT013 PT017 PT021 PT022 PT028
propositions: Tests lack a per-test execution budget in local `make test` and bare `pytest`, allowing tests to burn CI time or hang indefinitely; CI lanes have inconsistent or missing timeout enforcement
Subprocess calls with `subprocess.run()` are unchecked for return codes (336 PLW1510 findings), masking failures in tests and production code
Pytest linting rules (1811 PT findings) are not adopted in the ruff `select` configuration, leaving style violations undetected in CI
Hygiene scripts `check_wall_clock_asserts.py` and `check_raw_git_writes.py` run only in CI workflows but are not reachable via local `make lint`
Integration-tier tests exceed a 20-second timeout budget and require explicit per-test overrides with documentation
